Privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy: data we collect | PackJoyU
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.metaDescription: How PackJoyU collects, uses and protects personal data from quote requests, sample orders and cookies, and how to exercise your privacy rights.
Privacy.intro: This page explains what personal data PackJoyU collects through this website, why, and how long we keep it.
Privacy.contactLink: Contact us through the inquiry form

collected.title: Data we collect
items: Inquiries and quote requests: your name, email, company, phone, country and message, plus the products and options you choose.
Sample requests: the above plus your shipping address.
Logos you upload in the customizer or inquiry form. A logo may be uploaded before you submit the inquiry.
Shared custom designs you create in the 3D customizer.
Referral and campaign data sent by your browser with an inquiry: the page you came from, search keywords and UTM parameters.

Technical data: your IP address and, if you allow analytics, anonymous page-performance metrics. We use the IP address for rate limiting and abuse protection, send it to our security-verification provider to check that you are not a bot, and record it in admin security (audit) logs. We also store the country derived from your IP address with an inquiry to help detect spam.

purpose.title: Why we use it
items: To answer inquiries, prepare quotes and ship samples.
To protect the site from spam and abuse (security check and rate limits).
With your consent only: to measure site performance with anonymous analytics. Sending an inquiry does not require this consent.

items.designs: Shared custom designs expire after 180 days (the link then returns “410 Gone”) and are deleted 90 days later.
items.designsInquiry: Designs attached to an inquiry are kept as long as that inquiry and are anonymized or deleted with it.
items.logos: Logos not attached to an inquiry are usually deleted within 48 hours of upload (they become eligible for deletion after 24 hours and a cleanup runs daily), except logos still used by an unexpired saved design.
items.sampleEmail: For sample requests (one per email every 30 days), the email used for this limit is cleared after 30 days.
items.rateLimit: Rate-limit counters use your IP address and a hashed (not readable) version of your email address, and expire when their limit window ends — at most 30 days.
items.audit: Admin security (audit) logs, including IP addresses, are deleted after 365 days.
items.adminSessions: Admin sessions end after 2 hours of inactivity.
items.inquiries: Inquiries are anonymized 2 years after the last activity on the inquiry (our reply or a status change): we delete or anonymize contact details, messages, shipping address, email correspondence, uploaded logos and logo settings in the configuration, internal staff notes about the inquiry, referral/source data sent by the browser, and sample shipment tracking numbers; only non-personal statistics are kept.
items.inquiriesContact: Contact details are kept while that contact still has inquiries that have not been anonymized.
items.onRequest: On request, we delete or anonymize contact details, messages, shipping address, email correspondence, uploaded logos and logo settings in the configuration, internal staff notes about the inquiry, referral/source data sent by the browser, and sample shipment tracking numbers; only non-personal statistics are kept. Records in our database are deleted or anonymized immediately.
items.deletionCopies: Copies of inquiry notification emails in our business inbox are deleted manually within 30 days of your request. Logs kept by our service providers (for example email delivery and hosting logs) are deleted according to each provider’s own retention period.
items.oldReplies: Replies to old emails about an anonymized inquiry are not added to it.
items.exports: Data exports are delivered to you as a file; no copy is kept on the server.
items.cleanup: An automatic cleanup runs once a day.

cookies.title: Cookies, local storage and consent
items: Your choice is stored in your browser’s localStorage under the key pj-consent, not in a cookie. It records whether you allowed optional analytics, and when.
Optional analytics load only after you allow them. If you decline, no analytics identifier is created.
Your choice expires after 12 months, and we ask again.
You can change or withdraw analytics consent at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer. Withdrawing analytics stops analytics only. It does not delete inquiry records.

items: The inquiry form and email always work, whatever you choose in cookie settings.

meta.description: How a custom packaging order works at PackJoyU, step by step: brief and dieline, sample, printing, die-cutting and assembly, quality control and shipping.

Factory.title: From brief to finished packaging
Factory.lead: See how your order moves, step by step, from the first dieline to shipping.

1.title: Brief & dieline
1.desc: You share your product, quantities and artwork, and we agree the box structure and a dieline to match.

2.title: Sample
2.desc: A sample is made from the agreed dieline so you can check size, fit and print before the run.

3.title: Print
3.desc: Once the sample is approved, your artwork is printed on the selected material.

4.title: Die-cut & assembly
4.desc: Printed sheets are die-cut, folded and assembled, with inserts added where your design needs them.

5.title: QC & ship
5.desc: Finished packaging is checked against the approved sample, packed and prepared for shipment.
